annotations.title: Brands the AI answers name that you do not track

description: The brands a project's AI answers name that are not tracked as competitors (another brand offering the same thing), most-seen first: in how many answers and tracked queries, how often, their average position among the brands named, one query that named them, and when they were last seen. They count in no metric until tracked, so this is where to find competitors worth adding with create_competitor (their websites are not known here; confirm them with the user). Needs checks to have run; after a project is created its first checks run straight away. dateFrom and dateTo (YYYY-MM-DD) default to the last 30 days.

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes; a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode (SERP/Shopping have no AI text mentions)

name: list_untracked_competitors
